mapper.select: SELECT fact.identity_id AS fact_identity_id, fact.credential_id AS fact_credential_id, fact.role_assignment_id AS fact_role_assignment_id, fact.event_id AS fact_event_id, fact.initialized_at, identity.normalized_email, identity.display_name, identity.created_at AS identity_created_at, credential.credential_type, credential.password_hash, credential.issued_at AS credential_issued_at, credential.expires_at AS credential_expires_at, credential.invalidated_at AS credential_invalidated_at, role.role_key, role.assigned_at AS role_assigned_at, role.revoked_at AS role_revoked_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM iam_credentials current WHERE current.identity_id = fact.identity_id) AS identity_credential_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM iam_platform_role_assignments current WHERE current.identity_id = fact.identity_id) AS identity_role_assignment_count FROM iam_platform_admin_bootstrap_facts fact JOIN iam_identities identity ON identity.id = fact.identity_id JOIN iam_credentials credential ON credential.id = fact.credential_id JOIN iam_platform_role_assignments role ON role.id = fact.role_assignment_id JOIN iam_outbox_events event ON event.event_id = fact.event_id WHERE fact.bootstrap_key = 'DEFAULT_PLATFORM_ADMIN'

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_credentials WHERE credential_type = 'INITIAL_PLATFORM_PASSWORD' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM iam_platform_role_assignments WHERE role_key = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_platform_admin_bootstrap_facts (bootstrap_key, identity_id, credential_id, role_assignment_id, event_id, initialized_at) VALUES ('DEFAULT_PLATFORM_ADMIN', #{identityId}, #{credentialId}, #{roleAssignmentId}, #{eventId}, #{initializedAt})
